author: AlvaroMorata
body:
That is it. I am going to quit clans. I didn't want to do this, but I think it's time... Joining a clan in the first place was unbelievable, it was one of the best things I did in mincraft. But after a while things started to get all serious, and that is not something I wanted to happen... I joined a clan for fun.. Not to create enemy's. For a long time I had to fight with other players, arguing and that is not what this community is about.. People are taking this way to seriously, It's just a game of blocks called Minecraft... I am sorry for making enemy's. I am sorry if I did anything to offend you...

I would also like to give a few thanks to the people who gave me a chance:

The Whole Atomic Team, for giving me the chance to join a clan.
Sparkz, 3picRises for being them people I could speak to.
Jozz for being that person.
SaberCross.

I would also like to say sorry:
To TheCaliand for being an idiot to you.
Remy Idk.
